Container.Name: lian-li-linux
Container.Overview:
Lian Li Linux: open-source replacement for L-Connect 3. Fan curves, RGB/LED effects, LCD streaming and sensor gauges for Lian Li fans, AIOs, Strimers and wireless dongles. Runs the hardware daemon plus the full desktop GUI, which you open in the browser through noVNC.
Privileged mode is required for USB/HID access and hwmon temperature sensors. Run only one copy: the daemon must be the sole owner of the Lian Li hardware.
Not affiliated with Lian Li Industrial Co., Ltd.
Container.Requires: Lian Li USB devices (controller, AIO, LCD, or TX/RX dongles) connected to the Unraid server.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: noVNC web interface for the Lian Li Linux GUI.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Daemon configuration, fan curves, profiles, templates and managed LCD assets.

Config.Name: LCD media
Config.Description: Images, videos and fonts to pick from in the GUI for LCD screens. Browse to /media/lianli in the file dialog.

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Optional password for the web UI. Leave empty for none (only on a trusted LAN).

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Daemon log level: error, warn, info, debug, trace.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID the daemon and GUI run as (owner of AppData).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID the daemon and GUI run as.
